section.title: Versioning
section.description: Review recent immutable snapshots from the Agent configuration, compare changes, and revert safely.

history.title: Agent history
history.description: Recent snapshots committed on the Agent.
history.empty: No previous versions are available yet. Save new agent changes to create history.

enable.title: Enable agent versioning
enable.description: Once enabled, every future agent update on the main branch creates a new immutable version.
enable.confirmMessage: This operation is permanent. Once versioning is enabled for this agent, it cannot be disabled.
enable.successMessage: Agent versioning is now enabled for this campaign agent.
enable.errorMessage: The agent versioning setting could not be enabled.
